title: Metabolic and laboratory interpretation slice
content: Evaluation registry slice focused on diabetes, HbA1c interpretation, average glycemia, discordant laboratory values, anemia-related confounding, and symptom-to-lab alignment. Representative queries involve elevated HbA1c, blurred vision, polyuria, and follow-up monitoring.

title: Cardiovascular symptom and risk slice
content: Evaluation registry slice focused on hypertension risk factors, lifestyle modification, heart failure symptoms, orthopnea, ankle edema, and exercise intolerance. Representative queries involve risk-factor lookup, triage, and symptom-to-condition linking.

title: Respiratory and urgent-care slice
content: Evaluation registry slice focused on pneumonia warning signs, COPD chronic symptoms, chronic sputum and cough, dyspnea, low oxygen, confusion, and urgent escalation cues. Representative queries involve differential hints and severity recognition.

title: Multi-comorbidity management slice
content: Evaluation registry slice focused on atrial fibrillation with concomitant heart failure and COPD, anticoagulation planning, rate-control strategy, decompensation risk, and bleeding-risk trade-offs. Representative queries involve multi-hop reasoning rather than single-fact retrieval.
